## Calmer conversations Preview

Rei is a desktop workspace for bingo. This preview bundles platform-matching **bingo v0.6.5** from [`e036efe2e029bcbef9c191a326fafc126d935a99`](https://github.com/yexrob/bingo/commit/e036efe2e029bcbef9c191a326fafc126d935a99), the same Core as v0.1.1.

### Changed since v0.1.1

**Conversation and tool activity**
- Streamed answers reveal at an even pace, new words fade in and a soft caret marks the live end. History still renders at once.
- Thinking shows a two-line live peek and a timer, then settles to "Thought for 4.2s".
- Tool runs describe live work ("Running command…", "Editing…") with per-tool timers, a quiet rail across multi-tool runs, a one-time completion check and a live terminal tail. Finished runs compact to "Used 4 tools", with failures counted.
- Failed turns become a titled card (for example "Rate limited") with **Retry**; interrupted turns offer **Continue**. Your messages can be copied or edited in the composer, and the latest answer can be retried.
- Calmer Markdown rhythm and code blocks. Diffs in tool results, permission prompts and Review share one colored diff view.
- All motion respects the system Reduce Motion setting.

**Workspace**
- Paste or drop images into the composer.
- Desktop notifications and a dock/taskbar badge when a conversation needs you or finishes while Rei is in the background (Settings → Desktop notifications).
- Command palette with keyboard navigation, cross-project search and quick actions. Session rows gain Rename, Pin, Export and Delete actions, pinned threads and date groups.
- Review is one click from the header (Ctrl/⌘+Shift+G) and now includes new untracked files. Terminal (Ctrl/⌘+`) and Browser (Ctrl/⌘+Shift+B) have shortcuts; browser, terminal and review panels can be resized.
- Esc stops the agent only from the composer or conversation, never while dismissing menus or editing elsewhere.
- Internal temporary paths display as "Personal space", home folders as `~`. Simplified Chinese coverage is complete, including native dialogs on Chinese systems.

**Reliability**
- A slow or busy window no longer stops running agents: event delivery pauses and resynchronizes instead of terminating every bingo process.
- A slow read no longer drops the connection; unknown future runtime events are ignored safely; when bingo exits unexpectedly, the error includes a redacted tail of its diagnostics.
- Long sessions use less memory and render streamed output once per frame; failed session recovery retries automatically; drafts are saved when the window closes.

### Before installing

- **Preview quality; manual updates.** Verify your download against `SHA256SUMS.txt` before opening it.
- **macOS still requires per-app manual approval after downloading.** Builds are ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. After attempting to open your verified copy of Rei, use **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway** for that specific app, then confirm the macOS prompt. Do not disable Gatekeeper or other system security globally.
- Windows builds are not publisher-signed and may show security warnings. **Windows is not at full agent-tool parity:** bingo's agent `Bash` tool is Unix-only.
- A model provider still needs configuration. Automated tests use a local fake provider, not real cloud OAuth/accounts.
- Attach a project folder for work you want to keep there; the scratch workspace is temporary. The terminal runs your local shell with your user privileges.

Installers are published only after all native build and automated verification jobs succeed. These checks do not replace hands-on device testing or an independent security audit.
